_appid: No Steam release matches this build: the 1995 Sir-Tech DOS CD release of Jagged Alliance is not sold standalone on Steam. The nearest listing, 'Jagged Alliance Gold' (appid 283270), is a different SKU that bundles Deadly Games and its expansions, and auto-matching otherwise lands on Jagged Alliance 3 (appid 1084160). Display fields are hand-written.
description: Jagged Alliance (1995 Sir-Tech / Madlab, DOS CD release via DOSBox-X)
long: Jagged Alliance is the 1995 turn-based tactics game that founded the series. Hired to retake the island of Metavira from the mercenary Lucas Santino, you recruit a squad from the A.I.M. roster - each merc with their own salary demands, skills, quirks and grudges - and liberate the island one sector at a time. Days are spent tapping the island's Fallow trees for the medicinal sap that funds the campaign, then fighting sector-by-sector engagements on an isometric grid with action points, line of sight, stances, and per-limb damage. Between battles you manage payroll, equipment, training of native workers, and the mercs' opinions of each other, since personality clashes can make a merc quit mid-contract.
name: Jagged Alliance
short: Turn-based tactics on the island of Metavira: hire A.I.M. mercenaries, tap the Fallow trees, and take Metavira back one sector at a time.
